(3) P31 vs P48 for instructors reviewing AI-made outcomes and rubrics, resolved to P48. (4) P09 vs P66 for explaining a ban, resolved to P66. (5) modality on consequence sentences (must-not/must vs informs), resolved to informs. (6) unit_stance neutral vs encourage vs permit on disclosure sentences, resolved case by case. Every unit found by only one coder was checked against the source and kept: A found 12 (mostly the intro list of uses and rationale sentences), B found 6 (CETL role sentence, instructor-allows-AI sentence, Option labels, Option 2 'only with prior permission' sentence, 'Read your course syllabus carefully'). Fit notes and uncovered notes from both coders were merged.
